summary: Fixed unreleased migrations 0012 (drop/recreate the elevation index, exact integer feet-to-metres rounding half away from zero) and 0013 (full_name without concat_ws, unsupported in SQLite 3.40.1), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (cp1252 for collectors, deferred seeds for forward references, complete basis map). A fresh build passes all checks and a copy of the 1.6.0 database upgrades to an identical schema and identical rows.
